subject: Conditional top-up request for accelerator credits — invoice / SOW path
messages:
From: Sasha Trivedi <sasha@foundrylabs.com>

Cc: Foundry Labs Billing <billing@foundrylabs.com>

Subject: Request: one-off top-up for accelerator cohort (credits exhausted)

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from Foundry — our current accelerator cohort burned through the sandbox credits much faster than expected during demo week. We were hoping Redwood could make a one-off top-up available so the teams can finish integration work and run post-demo analysis.

High-level ask:
- One-time credit top-up: $15,000 equivalent in hosted credits (token/embedding mix)
- Invoiced to Foundry Labs (we need an official invoice and SOW addendum)
- Ideally processed this week — teams are blocked on a couple of live demos.

Procurement notes: our finance team needs an itemized SOW line (description + quantity/units) and a billable entity name for PO processing. I copied our billing address in the attachments (PO stub) — billing@foundrylabs.com can accept the invoice.

Can Redwood do a one-off invoice-backed top-up (rather than a promo credit), or do we need to convert into a prepaid/dedicated commitment? If invoice is possible, what is the timeline and what documentation do you need from us?

Attaching: cohort-usage-summary.csv (stub)

Thanks — Sasha

Sasha Trivedi

sasha@foundrylabs.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: one-off top-up for accelerator cohort (credits exhausted)

Hi Sasha — thanks for the context and the usage CSV. Sorry to hear demo week caused the spike, but we can absolutely help.

Two possible paths we typically use for accelerator programs:
1) Promo credit top-up: we add promo credits to your account immediately (fast), but they are non-invoiceable and show as promotional line items (no SOW addendum).
2) Invoice-backed top-up: we issue an invoice / SOW addendum for a one-time purchase of hosted credits. This is itemized, tax-ready, and goes through procurement (net30 is standard).

From your note it sounds like procurement wants an invoice and a signed SOW addendum — path (2) is the right fit. To move forward we need:
- Confirmation of the exact USD amount you want invoiced ($15,000 ok per your note?)
- Legal name and billing address to appear on the invoice and SOW
- Any PO number and preferred invoice recipient (billing@foundrylabs.com is fine)

I’m looping in Lauren (finance) and Priyom (partner ops / SOW routing) to handle the billing and SOW addendum. I’ve attached a short SOW addendum template that our legal team uses for one-off credit purchases — you can add your PO and sign when ready.

Attachments: redwood-sow-topup-template.docx (stub)

Next steps proposal:
- You confirm amount + legal details (today)
- Finance issues pro forma / invoice (1 business day after confirmation)
- SOW addendum routed for signature in parallel (2–3 business days)

If you prefer, we can also do an immediate promo credit while the invoice moves through procurement, but promo credits cannot later be converted into an invoice-backed purchase (they’re separate ledger entries).

Let me know which route you want — happy to expedite.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
